HP Aruba J9283D 10G SFP+ to SFP+ 3m DAC Cable – High-Performance Networking Solution in Bangladesh

Boost your network speed and efficiency with the HP Aruba J9283D 10G SFP+ to SFP+ 3m Direct Attach Copper (DAC) Cable. This high-performance, cost-effective solution is ideal for connecting HP Aruba switches, servers, and storage devices in enterprise and data center environments. With 10 Gigabit Ethernet (10GbE) support, it delivers ultra-low latency, excellent signal integrity, and reliable data transmission over a 3-meter distance.


The J9283D DAC cable is plug-and-play, requiring no additional configuration, making it perfect for IT professionals looking for easy deployment and seamless compatibility with Aruba and other SFP+ enabled devices.


Key Features of HP Aruba J9283D 10G SFP+ to SFP+ 3m DAC Cable

  • High-Speed 10GbE Connectivity – Supports 10 Gigabit Ethernet for fast and stable networking.
  • 3-Meter Length – Ideal for short-range, high-density connections within racks.
  • Low Power Consumption – Passive copper design reduces energy usage and heat.
  • Aruba Certified – Guaranteed compatibility with Aruba switches and network devices.
  • Hot-Pluggable SFP+ Interface – Easy installation without system downtime.
  • Cost-Effective Solution – More affordable than fiber optic transceivers and patch cables.
  • Durable Construction – High-quality shielding minimizes interference and ensures long-lasting performance.
  • Standards Compliant – Meets SFP+ MSA and IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-CX1 standards for interoperability.
